title: Quantized mesh compression (Draco)
description: Draco encodes and decodes a synthetic wavy grid at three quantization levels. Vertex reordering is checked with nearest-neighbor distances.

prompt: Quantized mesh compression. Inspect the locally generated results and rerun the included recipe when changing simulation inputs.
